name: page-to-pdf
description: Chrome extension that saves pages as vector PDFs without the print dialog.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: rm -f page-to-pdf.zip && zip -qr page-to-pdf.zip manifest.json background.js offscreen.html offscreen.js popup.html popup.css popup.js lib content icons && echo page-to-pdf.zip
